description: Load one or several documents into the Context Library so the Oracle and Genesis chats can search and read them. Supported: text, markdown, CSV, JSON, PDF with a text layer, and Word/PowerPoint/Excel files. Give each file a filename and exactly one of: text (the content as a string), data (base64 bytes), or path (a local file, stdio server only). Returns one entry per file in request order: { doc, created, indexedChunks } (created is false when identical bytes are already stored) or { error, message }; a failing file does not stop the others. At most 20 files and about 25 MiB per call; the library holds at most 200 active documents. Requires an owner or operator key with the write scope. Only call when the person asked to add these documents.

contentType.description: Optional media type; inferred from the extension when omitted.

data.description: The document bytes, base64-encoded (up to about 10 MiB).

filename.description: The file name with its extension, for example call-notes.md. Optional with path (defaults to the path's name).

path.description: A local file path. Stdio server only.

title.description: Optional display title (defaults to the file name).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_upload_library_documents
title: Upload library documents
